known_target_cautions: ratio_* targets are unstable when the denominator is zero; do not use them as primary surrogate targets.
peak_bulk_phase/time are not physically informative when peak bulk utilization is exactly zero because argmax ties select the initial row.
sample_region is a DOE sampling label, not a physical predictor.
completion_* mechanism columns are solver outputs and must not be used as deployable surrogate inputs.
